Dear [Mr Craik](../persons.html#379)
About the name of [the Spanish book](../books.html#126) which certainly is rather suggestive of the uncomplimentary riddle ‘What is the difference between Truth and Fiction?

History and Her story My book is really both - a bit of real history, and then a collection of the wonderful stories and ballads about it.
I do not know any book that does combine them both, and I want to mark that this does.
I shall send the first half dozen chapters which are done.
I am writing to [Mr Murray](../persons.html#2312)[^2]

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: Black-edged paper.

[^2]: She wanted Murray\'s permission to use some of Lockhart\'s Ancient Spanish Ballads in her The Story of the Christians and the Moors in Spain.
